cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(r36_slip_app LANGUAGES CXX)
  include(CTest)
endif()
get_filename_component(_slip_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
option(R36_SLIP_WITH_HORIZON "Build the real Horizon Stereo provider for slip input" ${R36_COMPARE_WITH_HORIZON})
if(NOT TARGET r36_motion_features)
  add_subdirectory("${_slip_root}/features/visual_motion" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/motion_features")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET perception_native_config)
  add_subdirectory("${_slip_root}/scheduling/config" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/native_config")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET perception::sdk)
  find_package(perception_full_shared_sdk CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET platform_metrics)
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  add_library(platform_metrics STATIC "${_slip_root}/features/metrics/backend/src/platform_metrics.cpp"
    "${_slip_root}/features/metrics/backend/src/bpu_metrics.cpp")
  target_include_directories(platform_metrics PUBLIC "${_slip_root}/features/metrics/backend/include")
  target_compile_features(platform_metrics PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_link_libraries(platform_metrics PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
  if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(platform_metrics PUBLIC psapi)
  endif()
endif()
add_library(slip_timeline STATIC src/slip_timeline.cpp)
target_include_directories(slip_timeline PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(slip_timeline PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
add_executable(r36_slip_runner src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE slip_timeline perception_native_config perception::sdk platform_metrics)
target_compile_features(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  target_sources(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE "${_slip_root}/features/camera/src/mo_camera.cpp")
  target_include_directories(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE "${_slip_root}/features/camera/include"
    "${_slip_root}/features/camera/vendor/mo" "${_slip_root}/core/include" "${_slip_root}/compare/runner/include")
  target_compile_definitions(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE R36_SLIP_WITH_CAMERA=1)
  target_link_libraries(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
  foreach(directory IN LISTS PSDK_LINK_DEPENDENCY_DIRS)
    target_link_options(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE "-Wl,-rpath-link,${directory}")
  endforeach()
endif()
if(R36_SLIP_WITH_HORIZON)
  find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc imgcodecs)
  include("${_slip_root}/cmake/nv12.cmake")
  if(NOT TARGET horizon_stereo)
    set(STEREO_BUILD_HORIZON_RUNNER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(STEREO_BUILD_CODEC_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory("${_slip_root}/features/stereo/runner" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/horizon_runner")
  endif()
  add_library(slip_stereo_provider STATIC "${_slip_root}/features/stereo/src/stereo_provider.cpp")
  target_include_directories(slip_stereo_provider PUBLIC "${_slip_root}/features/stereo/include"
    PRIVATE "${_slip_root}/compare/runner/include" "${_slip_root}/core/runtime/include")
  target_include_directories(slip_stereo_provider SYSTEM PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_compile_features(slip_stereo_provider PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_definitions(slip_stereo_provider PRIVATE R36_ONLINE_WITH_HORIZON=1)
  target_link_libraries(slip_stereo_provider PUBLIC perception::sdk stereo_nv12 ${OpenCV_LIBS} PRIVATE horizon_stereo)
  target_link_libraries(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE slip_stereo_provider)
  target_compile_definitions(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE R36_SLIP_WITH_HORIZON=1)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
  target_compile_options(slip_timeline PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
  target_link_options(r36_slip_runner PRIVATE /MANIFEST:EMBED
    "/MANIFESTINPUT:${_slip_root}/sdk/cmake/windows_utf8.manifest")
endif()
if(WIN32)
  add_custom_command(TARGET r36_slip_runner POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "$<TARGET_FILE:perception::sdk>" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:r36_slip_runner>")
  if(R29_WITH_ORT)
    find_file(_slip_ort_runtime onnxruntime.dll PATHS "${ORT_ROOT}/lib" "${ORT_ROOT}/bin" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
  elseif(ORT_ROOT)
    find_file(_slip_ort_runtime onnxruntime.dll PATHS "${ORT_ROOT}/lib" "${ORT_ROOT}/bin" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
  endif()
  if(_slip_ort_runtime)
    add_custom_command(TARGET r36_slip_runner POST_BUILD
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${_slip_ort_runtime}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:r36_slip_runner>")
  endif()
  if(MSVC AND TARGET perception_sdk)
    add_custom_command(TARGET r36_slip_runner POST_BUILD
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} "-DSOURCE=$<TARGET_PDB_FILE:perception_sdk>"
        "-DDESTINATION=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:r36_slip_runner>" -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/copy_pdb_if_exists.cmake")
  endif()
endif()
install(TARGETS r36_slip_runner RUNTIME DESTINATION lib/perception_ros_so_demo)
if(BUILD_TESTING AND NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  add_executable(slip_timeline_contract_test "${_slip_root}/validation/slip_timeline_test.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(slip_timeline_contract_test PRIVATE slip_timeline)
  add_test(NAME slip_timeline_contract COMMAND slip_timeline_contract_test)
endif()
